knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Symptoms are reported before the shift and the site policy decides on attendance. The others place the risk on patients or hide symptoms.
Immunity records show whether a worker is protected against infections relevant to their work. The other options are not the purpose.
Covering, reporting and following the site rule protects patients and food. The other options expose patients or the worker to risk.

practicalCriteria: The learner states the illness reporting route and names the person who receives the report.
The learner lists the records they must keep and the records their employer must hold.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Signed statement of the reporting route
Copy of the site staff illness policy reviewed by the learner
stopWorkCriteria: A worker with active symptoms of an infectious illness is about to enter a care area
A worker has an open infected lesion and no cover is available
